plans.description: OID4VP 1.0 Final, SD-JWT VC, unsigned by-value request (redirect_uri client id prefix), direct_post. This is the profile Inji Verify 1.0 serves to wallets today and the one MOSIP ran manually in inji-verify#2013.

readiness.description: The certifiable OID4VP HAIP profile: signed request objects fetched by reference, x509_hash client ids and encrypted direct_post.jwt responses.

requires.name: response_mode=direct_post.jwt (encrypted authorization responses)
requires.note: Every verifier on the OIDF HAIP certified list uses direct_post.jwt.

requires.name: client_id_prefix=x509_hash with signed request_uri
requires.note: Inji Verify 1.0 signs request objects only for decentralized_identifier client ids.

requires.name: credential_format=iso_mdl (mdoc presentations)
requires.note: Required only for the mdoc variant of the HAIP plan.

requires.name: SD-JWT VC with DCQL query language
